notes: Manage-tab overhaul - Orders are now scannable cards with type icons, real status pills (REFUNDED/UNPAID), live count and a refunded filter; receipt is a proper thermal slip with VOIDED/REFUNDED stamps, dashed separators and complete line items (tax, discounts, delivery, loyalty, customer); Kitchen is a true KDS - FIFO queue, elapsed-time urgency badges, always-visible items with size variants and kitchen-verb action buttons; Shift got a session hero, icon stat tiles, denomination fixes and a web-safe close flow; Manage hub regrouped into sections; product editor has a searchable category picker and reordered fields; all inline editors use full-size fields; confirmations and errors now work in the browser build (Alert.alert sweep).
